verses.text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.translation: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.translation: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.translation: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.translation: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––

verses.text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verses.translation: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,

verses.text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verses.translation: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts

verses.text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.translation: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.translation: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.translation: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verses.translation: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,

verses.text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.translation: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verses.translation: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails

verses.text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.translation: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verses.translation: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verses.translation: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translation: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!

verses.text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verses.translation: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.translation: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.translation: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.translation: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’

verses.text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.translation: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.translation: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verses.translation: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn

verses.text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.translation: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.translation: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-

verses.text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.translation: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.

verses.text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verses.translation: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?

verses.text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translation: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translation: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.translation: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.translation: We have created all things in due measure;

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.translation: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: Everything they do is noted in their records:

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.translation: every action, great or small, is recorded.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verses.translation: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,

verses.text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.translation: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
